name: Beresheet
fact: First privately-funded lunar landing attempt — Israeli non-profit SpaceIL, 585 kg lander. Reached lunar orbit but a gyroscope failure during descent led to engine shutdown and a crash at ~150 m/s. Carrying a 'lunar library' of human knowledge etched on nickel discs, plus a sample of tardigrades — extremophiles capable of cryptobiosis — that may or may not have survived the impact. Inspired Beresheet 2 (planned).
capability: Demonstrated that a small private team can reach the Moon. The crash itself surfaced lessons about descent-engine restart and IMU redundancy adopted by later commercial landers.
